excerpts.text: Today, the World Health Organization (WHO) released its [2024 World Malaria Report](https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240104440), an annual report that provides a comprehensive update on global and regional malaria data and trends.
According to the 2024 World Malaria Report:
The rate of malaria cases (i.e. cases per 1,000 at-risk) increased slightly from 2022 and has not improved over the past decade.
Meanwhile, malaria deaths have declined every year over the past decade, with the exception of a significant spike during the onset of COVID-19 that offset those gains.
